metaDescription: Disney+ APK download for Android: get the official Disney Plus app 26.21.0 from Google Play, with plans, downloads, kids' profiles and playback fixes.

faq.q: How do I install Disney+ on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Disney+ and check the developer is Disney before tapping Install. It needs Android 6.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Disney and may be altered, so the safest way to use Disney+ is the official listing.
The app is free to install, but you need a Disney+ subscription to watch. Plans and prices vary by country, and some include ads.

faq.q: Can I download Disney+ films to watch offline?
faq.a: Yes, on supported plans. Tap the download icon on a film or episode. Downloads must be renewed online now and then.

faq.q: Why does Disney+ show an error code?
faq.a: Most errors come from the connection or a sign-in problem. Update the app, restart your router or phone, and sign out and back in.
